claims.claim: On 2026-10-26 the Stripe-built @link account announced Link balance: users fund an agent and set amount and spending limits; rolling out to Instinct users in eligible US regions.
The Link balance limit is per purchase, not cumulative; purchases above it need approval; $0 disables unattended buying; each funding link allows $150 or less in USD.
Link terms: user is responsible for all agent-initiated transactions as if taken themselves, including those caused by bugs, hallucinations or misinterpretations, except Stripe technical failure.
Prepaid debit card agreement: Lead Bank issuer, funds not FDIC insured, stablecoin sold at each purchase, $50/$500 loss tiers, and software agents treated as authorized by the user.
Reg E 1005.2(m) defines unauthorized by absence of actual authority; Comment 2(m)-2 keeps the consumer liable for transfers by a person given authority until the institution is notified.
Stripe 2025 letter: $1.9T total volume, up 34%; $159B tender valuation; Link over 200 million users.
Stripe launched the Link agent wallet on 2026-04-29 with spend requests: each requires consumer approval before a one-time card or Shared Payment Token is shared.
Shared Payment Tokens carry usage_limits (currency, max_amount, expires_at), are bound to a seller profile, and can be revoked; scoping is server-side policy.
link-cli README limits: $500 per request, $500 daily, $20,000 per 30 days, 30-minute approval window.
Claude for Chrome attack success rate fell from 23.6% to 11.2% with mitigations on 123 test cases.
Magentic Marketplace found first-proposal bias creating 10-30x speed advantages and payment redirection under prompt injection for weaker models.
StakeBench: indirect injection ASR 41.67-68.59% and direct 76.85-92.28% across four shopping-agent configurations.
x402: Chainalysis reports over 100M cumulative transactions on Base through Q1 2026 but says mass adoption remains distant.
OpenAI moved Instant Checkout toward Apps in March 2026.
Mastercard Q2 2026: 'cards will prevail in an agentic world'; Agent Pay for Machines 30+ launch users; no agentic transaction count.
